# Projective Finance

> Projective Finance is a renewable energy lender in the United States. Builders upload project documents to Projective OS, Projective underwrites them against its credit standards, and deals that clear reach terms in 15 to 20 days and close in 3 to 6 weeks. Projective finances up to 100% of construction cost through a first lien senior facility, so builders keep full ownership. Qualified investors worldwide can lend into Projective pools.

## What Projective offers

- Development capital, construction loans and permanent debt for solar, battery storage and municipal renewable projects.
- Capital needs from about $500,000 to $25 million and above.
- No upfront equity from the builder. Up to 100% of construction cost financed.
- Multi project pipelines financed through a single vehicle on one ledger: one close, one set of fees.
- Loan servicing on Projective OS: every repayment, covenant and report on one ledger, visible to lenders for the life of the loan.
- Interest paid monthly on a fixed schedule.

## For investors

- Open to qualified investors worldwide: individuals, family offices, funds and institutions.
- Open an account from anywhere, fund in any currency, choose a position from development capital to permanent debt.
- Interest monthly or at maturity. Every position recorded on one auditable ledger.
- Availability subject to eligibility and local regulations. Nothing on the site is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.

## Common questions

### What does Projective finance?

Projective lends to renewable energy projects in the United States: commercial and community solar, battery storage and municipal projects such as schools. We offer development capital, construction loans and permanent debt, with capital needs from about $500,000 to $25 million.

### How quickly can a project get financed?

A builder uploads the project documents to Projective OS. A deal that clears our underwriting standards reaches terms in 15 to 20 days and closes in 3 to 6 weeks. In our Econergy case study, capital was committed four weeks after upload.

### Does the builder need to put in equity?

Often not. For projects with investment-grade municipal or utility offtake, Projective can fund up to 100% of construction cost through a senior first-lien facility. The builder keeps full ownership and the full project economics after debt service. Advance rates depend on offtaker credit, contract structure, and track record.

### How does underwriting work on Projective?

Projective OS reads every document, pulls out the terms that matter and tests each one against policy: offtake tenor against loan term, site control, interconnection status and debt service coverage at base and downside cases. An underwriter reviews the result and nothing moves without a human sign off. Every check is written down.

### Who can invest in a Projective pool?

Qualified investors worldwide, including individuals, family offices, funds and institutions. Investors open an account, fund in any currency and choose a position from development capital through construction lending to permanent debt, with interest paid monthly or at maturity. Availability is subject to eligibility and local regulations.

### How does Projective handle state-level RECs and tax credits?

We handle it. Projective packages RECs and other state and federal tax credits and sells them through our network of brokerage partners, so the builder never has to source buyers or manage filings. Every transaction is executed in full compliance with the relevant state and federal agencies.
